paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Kamma 112a: Ravina waited twelve months for Mar Acha (Rashi explains: this is his name). It is not known whether he was a Torah scholar.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קיב. gives Bava Kamma 112a by convention without a new named edition check.

Hyman attributes this-is-his-name to Rashi without a fresh comment check. שהא is waited/delayed, with no supplied object such as payment; twelve months and Hyman’s uncertainty about Torah-scholar status remain. Full מר is preserved twice; Ravina is an unprefixed name, not separate Rav title evidence.
